What we do

Pest control services

From a small ant trail to a full termite infestation, our team finds the best solution for your home or business — using low-toxicity, low-odor treatments that are tough on pests and easy on your property.

Termite Control

Specialized termite identification, removal and prevention — including drywood and subterranean termites, local treatments and fumigation.

General Pest Control

Ants, cockroaches, spiders, crickets, moths and more — treated with tested, humane, highly effective methods.

Bed Bug Treatment

Thorough bed bug inspection and treatment to clear bedrooms and living spaces and keep them clear.

Rodent Control

Rats, mice and gophers removed and excluded — without poison where traps do the job — so they stop coming back.

Bee Removal

Safe, professional removal of bees and hives from homes, yards and commercial properties.

Flea & Fly Control

Fleas and flies handled at the source, inside and out, so your home stays comfortable year-round.

About us

A family name in pest control for over 70 years

At Hydrex Pest Control & Termite Co, we have been eliminating local pest problems since 1946. Our friendly and knowledgeable staff service both residential and commercial properties, and we are always happy to answer questions and find the best possible solution for your pest problem — for your peace of mind.

  • Members of PCOC and NPMA — held to a high standard of excellence
  • Eco-friendly methods and Reduced Impact Services
  • Fair, competitive pricing on all services
  • Free estimate and inspection — call today
